issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.finding: Three equal columns below 640 px forced 7-9 px labels and truncated secondary values.
issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.correction: Use two columns below 640 px and one column below 390 px; let the third card span both columns.

issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.finding: Wrapping combined with a calculated flex-basis could leave insufficient width for dialogue.
issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.correction: Switch to a stable single-column compact layout and make the listen button full width.

issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.finding: Fixed bottom offset ignored the iPhone home-indicator safe area.
issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.correction: Apply env(safe-area-inset-bottom) to offset and app-shell padding.

issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.finding: Several controls measured or could render below the 44 px touch target.
issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.correction: Enforce 44 px minimum block size on every interactive control.

issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.finding: 100vh can be unstable with the iOS browser chrome and virtual keyboard.
issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.correction: Use 100dvh with a 100vh fallback and safe-area padding.

issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.finding: Long engine metadata and action buttons could compete on narrow screens.
issuesDetectedBeforeStep5.correction: Allow wrapping and stack actions under 640 px.
